translations.web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
translations.asv: only, whereunto we have attained, by that same rule let us walk.
